# Star Rating

Page item for 1..N ratings built from native radio buttons: keyboard accessible, works with Dynamic Actions, validations, read-only and session state like any native item.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | item |
| Static ID | `AMC_STAR_RATING` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/starRating` |
| Modes | page item |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.0 |

> **APEXlang verification required.** These plug-in definition tokens are not yet confirmed by compiler truth: `component.supports`, `component.supportsSessionStateDataTypes`, `component.standardAttributes`, `callbacks.apiInterface`. Run `node tools/query-valid-props.mjs --component plugin --when type=ITEM` in the apexlang skill, fix `tools/lib/tokens.mjs` or `component.json` if needed, and rebuild before importing.

Stores the selected number (1..Maximum) in session state, or null when cleared. Supports apex.item() getValue/setValue/enable/disable so Dynamic Actions work as with native items.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `maxStars` | Maximum | integer | yes | `5` | Number of stars, 1 to 10. |
| `icon` | Icon | text |  | `fa-star` | Font APEX icon used for each step, for example fa-star, fa-heart or fa-circle. |
| `clearable` | Allow Clear | yesNo |  | `Y` | Show a small button that resets the rating to null. |
| `clearLabel` | Clear Button Label | text |  | `Clear rating` | Accessible label of the clear button (it is announced, not displayed). |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/star-rating/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_star_rating.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
